# HBI Studio

> Private hair extension studio in North Austin, Texas. Custom K-Tip extensions (small keratin bonds placed strand by strand) in premium Slavic hair, matched to the client's color and texture. By appointment only.

HBI Studio is run by Inna, a hair extension specialist with over 9 years of experience. Her first salon was in Kyiv; she has worked with clients in Austin since 2024.

## Services

- Free Consultation (20 to 30 minutes; pricing is confirmed before you commit)
- Hair Extension Installation (Hair Included)
- Hair Extension Installation (Client's Hair)
- Extension Reinstallation
- Extension Removal
- Premium Slavic Human Hair, from $450 per 100 g

Technique: Custom K-Tip with invisible bonds, so the hair moves like your own and the bonds stay hidden.
